description:
Out of the blue, Mikyung Lee gets a chance to change her life—by becoming a body double for Dokyung Cha, the glamorous CEO of PERTH Construction. Despite an impressive list of qualifications, Mikyung has never been able to pass a job interview because of the unsightly scar on her face. But in return for becoming a body double, she’s offered a chance to get surgery to remove it free of charge, and enough money to rescue her family from debt. Soon after assuming Dokyung Cha’s identity and entering into a world of wealth and power, she finds herself torn between steamy relationships with two gorgeous men. But how long can she go before someone figures out who she really is? And where’s the real Dokyung Cha, anyway?

(Source: Netcomics)
